items.title: Airport Shuttle Timetable
items.content: Which shuttle should Lina take if her flight leaves at 10:40 and she wants to arrive at the airport at least 90 minutes early?
items.passage: CityLink Shuttle Service runs daily from Central Station to Northgate Airport. Buses leave Central Station at 07:30, 08:00, 08:40, 09:15 and 10:00. The journey usually takes 35 minutes, but passengers are advised to arrive at the airport at least 90 minutes before departure for international flights. Tickets can be bought online or from the driver. The 08:40 service is often busy on weekdays because many business travellers use it.
items.author: Daniel Brooks

sourceData.instructions: Read the shuttle notice and choose the best answer.

items.title: Campus Recycling Facts
items.content: Complete the sentence: The university introduced the colour-coded bins to reduce ______.
items.passage: Last year, Brookdale University reviewed its waste system after a report showed that too many recyclable items were being thrown away with general rubbish. In response, the university introduced colour-coded bins across the campus and placed short explanations above each one. Staff also visited classes to explain how food containers, paper and batteries should be sorted. Within four months, recycling rates had improved by 18 percent. The facilities manager said the biggest change came from reducing contamination, which happens when the wrong materials are placed in recycling bins.
items.author: Neha Kapoor

sourceData.instructions: Use words from the passage to complete the sentence.

items.title: Startup Roles and Responsibilities
items.content: Match each employee to the responsibility they are described as leading.
items.passage: A small education technology company recently expanded its team. Marta now coordinates communication with schools and gathers feedback from teachers after trial lessons. Dev manages system stability and supervises software releases, especially before large client launches. Priyan focuses on user research and studies how learners move through the platform, identifying points where they lose motivation. Sofia prepares investor updates and tracks monthly revenue against the company target. As the business grows, team members increasingly need to work across departments rather than in isolation.
items.author: Elena Petrova

sourceData.instructions: Read the text and match each person to the correct responsibility.
sourceData.correctAnswer: Marta-school feedback; Dev-system stability; Priyan-user research; Sofia-revenue tracking

items.title: Social Media and Sleep
items.content: Decide whether the statement is True, False, or Not Given: The study proved that checking social media after 10 p.m. directly causes lower exam scores.
items.passage: Researchers at a regional college tracked the evening habits of 600 students over one semester. They found that students who used social media heavily late at night reported shorter sleep duration and more daytime tiredness than those who stopped earlier. The report also noted that many of the same students performed less consistently in weekly quizzes. However, the researchers warned that the relationship was complex. Factors such as part-time work, stress and poor study planning could also have influenced academic performance.
items.author: Senior Item Writer

sourceData.instructions: Read the text and decide whether the statement agrees with the information.

items.title: Urban Health Pilot
items.content: According to the passage, why did local clinics support the new walking-route project?
items.passage: A city health department launched a pilot scheme that marked short walking routes between transport hubs, clinics and shopping streets. The project was not designed simply as a tourism feature. Instead, planners wanted to encourage small amounts of daily movement among residents who said they had no time for formal exercise. Local clinics supported the scheme because many patients with early signs of lifestyle-related illness felt intimidated by gyms or could not commit to structured fitness programmes. Doctors argued that short, repeated walks integrated into normal routines were more realistic for these patients than ambitious exercise plans that were quickly abandoned.
items.author: Daniel Brooks

sourceData.instructions: Answer in no more than eight words.
sourceData.correctAnswer: Because short routine walks were more realistic for patients.
